text_block_list.text:
The days of running through the Twinkle 
Series with your horse girl will soon 
begin. Walking alongside you, her name 
is——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I'm Stay Gold. Nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'm planning go more wild than last time, 
but are you ready for this?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If it's with you, I feel like this'll be a 
good journey. To find an undiscovered 
golden route, let's go have some fun!

Just like this, with <chrname>, the battle against 
the Twinkle Series has begun!
